title: Decided cards: take them off, or keep them as the record?

decision.q: What happens to a decided card?

options.label: Off the board, into a searchable Record (decision records linked to commits)
options.act: Record view of closed cards as ADR-style entries; phase As built links to them
options.then: Take decided cards off the board and keep each as a decision record, linked to the commit that did it, in a searchable Record.

options.label: Stay on the board, collapsed as Handled (the Flex way)
Off the board, recorded in the plan files only (today)

why: Off the board, into a Record view. The board shows only what's open, so it stays a to-do list you can get to zero. A decided card becomes a short decision record (what was asked, what you picked, why, what it committed, the commit that did it) in a searchable Record tab. That's an ADR in shape, and GitHub's "Done but findable" in spirit. The phase file links to it instead of copying it.

unsure.why: Our board removes a card once it's decided and writes the outcome into the phase's As built. The Flex board keeps every card as "the record of how it was made". A general product has to pick one, and both have a cost: removal scatters the history across plan files, keeping makes the board grow forever.
